facts.fact: SYSROAD SA HOLDING entered a US$50 million public-private partnership with GAMTEL to upgrade the national broadband backbone from 40Gbps to 800Gbps; the record notes GAMTEL's release puts the signing ceremony on 24 December 2025 and does not name SYSROAD's home country.

A signed US$50 million public-private partnership in which private holding SYSROAD SA HOLDING upgrades the national broadband backbone of state operator GAMTEL, with a signing ceremony on 24 December 2025 per GAMTEL's release as cited in the record.
